scripts.test:e2e:server: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:preflight && npm run test:e2e:run
scripts.test:a11y: npm run test:e2e:preflight && playwright test tests/e2e/accessibility-public.spec.ts tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts
scripts.test:a11y:all: npm run test:e2e:preflight && playwright test tests/e2e/route-accessibility.spec.ts tests/e2e/dynamic-route-accessibility.spec.ts --project=authenticated-desktop --project=authenticated-mobile
scripts.test:visual: npm run test:e2e:preflight && playwright test tests/e2e/visual-public.spec.ts tests/e2e/visual-dashboard.spec.ts
scripts.quality: npm run ci:verify-workflow && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:visit-location && npm run test:e2e:preflight:test && npm run build
scripts.quality:browser: npm run test:e2e:preflight && npm run test:csp-production && npm run test:e2e:run
scripts.quality:release: npm run quality && npm run audit:dependencies && npm run quality:browser
